test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average of 52 numbers is 48.5. The average of the first 22 numbers is 59.8 and that of the last 32 numbers is 41.7. If the 21st and 22ⁿd numbers are excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
solution:
**Given:**

The average of 52 numbers = 48.5

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all items/The total number of items

**Calculation:**

Let the average of the remaining numbers be X

According to the question

The sum of all numbers = 52 × 48.5 = 2522

The sum of the first 22 numbers = 22 × 59.8 = 1315.6

The sum of the last 32 numbers = 32 × 41.7 = 1334.4

The sum of the 21st and 22ⁿd numbers = 1315.6 + 1334.4 - 2522 = 128

The sum of the remaining numbers = 2522 - 128 = 2394

The average of the remaining numbers = {2394over 50} = 47.88 

**∴ The required result will be 47.88.**
